title: Build same-invariant static profiles with small dissipation and a positive entropy gap
statement: At P0 choose Delta0>0 with E-Delta0 above Pauli minimum. Set m_R=Delta0/(R^2+3sigma^2), C_R=FD(M-m_R,0,E-Delta0), K_R=(m_R/2)[G_sigma(v-Re1)+G_sigma(v+Re1)], f_R=C_R+K_R. For large R these are smooth Schwartz admissible states with EXACT M,0,E, uniform warm core and global desaturation. Yet f_R->FD(M,0,E-Delta0) in L1, entropy gap to FD(M,0,E) tends a positive value, and D(f_R)<=C m_R=O(R^-2)->0.
